# EveryInfra agent plugin

> Public, host-portable agent integration for EveryInfra. It combines reusable skills with remote
> MCP connection metadata; it does not contain the private gateway implementation.

Canonical documentation:
- Public source: https://github.com/everyinfra/everyinfra-agent-plugins
- README: ./README.md
- AI discovery contract: ./docs/ai-discovery.md
- Architecture boundaries: ./docs/architecture.md
- Installation: ./docs/installation.md
- MCP install steps for agents: ./llms-install.md
- Troubleshooting: ./docs/troubleshooting.md
- Permissions and billing: ./docs/permissions.md
- AI API: https://everyinfra.com/en/products/ai
- REST-only product boundary: ./docs/rest-only.md
- Portable plugin manifest: ./plugins/everyinfra/plugin.json
- Skill router: ./plugins/everyinfra/skills/everyinfra/SKILL.md

Runtime endpoint: https://api.everyinfra.com/mcp
API documentation: https://everyinfra.com/en/docs

Current package boundary:
- MCP workflows: EveryData, EverySearch, EveryAI (AI API, free for accounts that have topped up),
  EverySolve
- REST-only guidance: EveryNumber, EveryMail, EveryProxy
- Ten skills total: one router, seven product skills, two outcome workflows

Do not infer live availability, price, billing, official marketplace approval, or app registration
from this file. Use live MCP discovery, public catalogs, and host status for those facts.
